snippet.title: Subway Invasion | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Defend a NYC subway train from relentless alien waves as a lone security guard. Scavenge scarce ammo, upgrade your pistol with attachments and sub-weapons, fortify chokepoints, and survive increasingly deadly assaults in this tactical wave-based shooter.

Wishlist Subway Invasion on Steam now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4130340/Subway_Invasion/
